# SW2URDF {{RELEASE_DATE}} Release Candidate / 候选版本

> **Draft only.** Publish only after manual SolidWorks validation and explicit maintainer approval.
>
> **当前仅为 Draft。** 必须完成 SolidWorks 手动验证，并由维护者明确确认“可以发布”后才能公开。

## English

### Added

- Added temporary SolidWorks collision previews for box, cylinder, sphere, component-box,
  simplified-mesh, accurate-mesh, visual-mesh, and convex-hull strategies.
- Added equivalent-inertia cuboid, principal-axis, and COM previews for checking mass properties
  before export.
- Added deterministic whole-tree Link coloring: hierarchy depth controls the palette range, while
  normalized left/right counterparts receive the same stable color.
- Added a topmost export-progress window and completion summary with file count, total size, elapsed
  time, and output directory.
- Added bilingual usage guidance, Joint-type explanations, direct-child-count help, README, Wiki,
  changelog, and Draft Release Notes.

### Changed

- Modernized the assembly exporter with a themed, scrollable WinForms layout and applied the same
  SolidWorks-compatible styling to the part exporter.
- Treats the material-name field as the URDF material ID; preset IDs update RGBA, while explicit
  RGBA and color-picker changes remain the direct per-Link override.
- Removed the maintained texture-image editor because the supported STL path cannot carry texture
  data. Existing serialized texture metadata remains readable for backward compatibility.
- Uses Link-selected geometry for collision fitting and keeps visual, collision, and inertial data
  as separate engineering outputs.

### Fixed

- Fixed SolidWorks mass-property read ordering, system units, tensor sign mapping, coordinate-frame
  conversion, COM placement, and principal-moment validation.
- Fixed zero or misplaced inertia data caused by invalid component selection, duplicate frame
  conversion, or failed API values; invalid physical data now blocks export with diagnostics.
- Fixed configuration loss across component preview transitions and removed false duplicate Joint
  validation after reopening the exporter.
- Fixed temporary collision/inertia preview host selection, nested-component transforms, visibility
  restoration, primitive orientation, and convex-hull display behavior.
- Fixed repeated theme passes disposing fonts still used by WinForms controls.
- Fixed 150% and 200% DPI sizing that could move footer actions outside the screen working area.
- Fixed the part exporter collision section overlapping the Finish button after localization or font
  scaling.

### Candidate Validation

- Debug x64 build completed without compilation errors.
- 119 focused automated tests passed for modern layout, collision previews, inertia conventions,
  frame conversion, automatic Link coloring, draft persistence, and installer policy.
- The local Release installer pipeline verifies the source commit, payload, SHA-256 checksum, and
  provenance before producing this candidate.

### Manual Validation Required Before Publication

- Test clean install, upgrade, and uninstall on the target SolidWorks versions.
- Verify the assembly and part exporter layouts at 100%, 150%, and 200% Windows scaling.
- Export representative ROS1 and ROS2 part, assembly, and production models.
- Compare every Link mass, COM, and inertia tensor with SolidWorks in the selected Link frame.
- Preview and export every collision strategy, including hidden and nested source components.
- Confirm configuration persistence, automatic Link colors, progress reporting, and generated files.

## 简体中文

### 新增功能

- 为包围盒、圆柱体、球体、组件包围盒、简化网格、精确网格、复用可视网格和凸包策略增加
  SolidWorks 临时碰撞体预览。
- 增加等效惯性长方体、主惯性轴和质心预览，用于导出前检查质量属性。
- 增加确定性的整棵 Link 树自动配色：层级深度决定冷暖范围，规范化后的左右对应 Link 使用
  相同且稳定的颜色。
- 增加始终置顶的导出进度窗口和完成摘要，显示文件数量、总体大小、耗时和输出目录。
- 增加中英文使用说明、Joint 类型解释、直属子 Link 数量说明、README、Wiki、变更记录和
  Draft Release Notes。

### 行为调整

- 装配体导出器改为带主题和滚动区域的现代 WinForms 布局，零件导出器同步采用与
  SolidWorks 兼容的视觉风格。
- 材质名称明确作为 URDF material ID；预设 ID 自动更新 RGBA，RGBA 数值和色卡仍是针对单个
  Link 的直接覆盖方式。
- 移除当前维护界面的纹理图片编辑入口，因为受支持的 STL 路线不能携带纹理；历史配置中的
  纹理元数据仍可读取，以保持兼容。
- 碰撞体拟合改用当前 Link 所选几何，并继续将 visual、collision、inertial 作为三个独立的
  工程输出处理。

### 已修复问题

- 修复 SolidWorks 质量属性 API 的读取顺序、系统单位、张量符号映射、坐标系变换、质心位置和
  主惯量校验。
- 修复组件选择无效、重复坐标变换或 API 返回失败导致的惯性全零或位置错误；物理数据无效时
  现在会阻止导出并给出诊断。
- 修复进入和退出零部件预览后配置丢失，以及重新打开导出器后错误报告 Joint 重名的问题。
- 修复临时碰撞体与惯性体的显示宿主、嵌套组件变换、可见性恢复、原语方向和凸包显示逻辑。
- 修复重复执行中文本地化和主题设置时，释放控件仍在使用的字体对象所导致的窗口创建失败。
- 修复 Windows 150% 和 200% 缩放下窗口超过屏幕工作区、底部操作按钮不可达的问题。
- 修复零件导出器在中文或字体缩放后，碰撞区域覆盖“完成”按钮的问题。

### 候选包验证

- Debug x64 构建无编译错误。
- 现代布局、碰撞预览、惯性约定、坐标系变换、自动 Link 配色、草稿持久化和安装策略共
  119 项重点自动化测试通过。
- 本地 Release 安装包流水线会在生成候选包前核对源码提交、载荷、SHA-256 和 provenance。

### 正式发布前必须完成的手动测试

- 在目标 SolidWorks 版本测试首次安装、覆盖升级和卸载。
- 在 Windows 100%、150% 和 200% 缩放下检查装配体与零件导出界面。
- 使用典型零件、装配体和复杂生产模型分别导出 ROS1 与 ROS2 功能包。
- 在所选 Link 坐标系下，将每个 Link 的质量、质心和惯性张量与 SolidWorks 逐项对照。
- 对全部碰撞策略执行预览和正式导出，包括源组件隐藏与嵌套的情况。
- 检查配置持久化、自动 Link 配色、进度信息和最终生成文件。
